t: Two phrases weighed against the sky
a: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلآنِ أَوْ تَمْلأُ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ
p: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi tamlaʾu-l-mīzān, wa subḥāna-Llāhi wa-l-ḥamdu lillāhi tamlaʾāni mā bayna-s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ
m: Praise be to Allah fills the scale. And glory to Allah and praise be to Allah fill what is between the heavens and the earth.
